assertions.summary: The frontend build now succeeds using the corrected manifest command. Validation first exposed that bare `tsc` was unavailable on PATH, so `.factory/services.yaml` was updated to use `npx tsc -b --pretty false && npx vite build`, and that command exited 0.

evidence.command: cd part64/frontend && tsc -b && npx vite build
evidence.observation: Initial run before manifest correction failed with `/bin/sh: line 1: tsc: command not found`.

evidence.command: cd part64/frontend && npx tsc -b --pretty false && npx vite build
evidence.observation: After updating `.factory/services.yaml`, the build completed successfully; Vite produced the production bundle and only reported the existing >500 kB chunk-size warning.

assertions.summary: Frontend and backend validators maintained or improved the documented baseline. Vitest exited 1 with the accepted baseline of 111 passing / 12 failing tests, ESLint exited 0 with 0 errors and 94 warnings, and all four Python suite commands exited 0.

evidence.observation: Vitest reported 28 passed / 6 failed files and 111 passed / 12 failed tests, matching the mission baseline.
ESLint finished with 0 errors and 94 warnings, improving on the accepted 10-error baseline.

assertions.summary: Docker stack build validation succeeded directly. `cd part64 && docker compose build` exited 0 and `cd part64 && docker compose config --quiet` also exited 0.

evidence.observation: Docker reported `Image part64-eta-mu-system Built` after completing the compose build.
Compose configuration validation exited 0 with no stderr output.

frictions.description: The original manifest build command used bare `tsc`, which was not available on PATH in this shell environment.
frictions.resolution: Updated `.factory/services.yaml` to use `npx tsc -b --pretty false && npx vite build` and re-ran the build successfully.

notes: Mission AGENTS guidance treats vitest 111 passing / 12 failing as an accepted baseline and only blocks on worse results.
